outcome: presence of bacteria in meconium and amniotic fluid
levels of inflammatory cytokines in amniotic fluid
levels of short chain fatty acids in meconium
cohort: The study involved 50 women undergoing planned cesarean section deliveries with no signs of intrauterine infection.
finding: The study found bacterial DNA and short-chain fatty acids in meconium and amniotic fluid, suggesting that the fetal gut is exposed to bacteria before birth, potentially influencing the developing immune system.
